rationale: The candidate is a general IT Manager with no mentioned experience in cybersecurity, NIST standards, or government compliance (NISPOM, CMMC) required for this specialized role.
The candidate has direct experience in iOS development using Swift and Xcode, knowledge of RESTful APIs, Git, and AWS, and has successfully deployed apps to the App Store.
The candidate is an IT Auditor and SOX Project Manager, whereas the job requires a hands-on System Administrator with a DoD Secret clearance and IAT Level 2 certification.
The candidate has over 6 years of experience with Python and Django, and possesses the required skills in Azure, GIT, and OOP.
The candidate has strong Java/JEE skills and the required years of experience, but lacks the mandatory Active Secret clearance and Security+ certification.
The candidate has extensive experience in Java, Angular, and various databases, matching nearly all the technical requirements for a Full Stack Engineer.
The candidate is a SIEM and vulnerability management specialist, whereas the job requires expertise in Okta and Identity and Access Management (IAM), which are not present in the resume.

The candidate has extensive experience (15+ years) across almost every required technology, including Java 8, Spring, Angular JS, Hibernate, Oracle, and various DevOps tools, matching the senior fullstack profile.

The candidate has extensive experience as an IT Security Engineer with NASA, specializing in risk management, security plans, and intrusion detection (Snort, QRadar), which aligns closely with the Information Assurance Engineer requirements.
The candidate is a highly experienced Sr. IT Project Manager with PMP certification and MS Project skills, but they lack the mandatory DoD SECRET clearance required for this federal role.
